0022600004.text: The Miami Heat open their 2026-27 season at home against the Minnesota Timberwolves, and both teams are still waiting on their first games of the year. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, while the Heat have no players listed as unavailable. The Heat lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Miami a 50% chance to win.
